item.text: I found the actual MOOSEDev source under `/Users/jcadam/code/moosedev`; I’m reading the current implementation now rather than relying on the older design notes.

The implementation has changed from the original design notes: it now applies a relevance floor, defaults to hiding superseded/deprecated records, and expands from matching seed records to a small set of linked neighbors.

Currently, `get_relevant_context` is pure symbolic: for a non-empty `topic`, it uses the MOOSE entity index’s `search_records` BM25 lexical search over each record’s `rdfs:label` weighted 2x and `hasDescription` weighted 1x, constrained to known architecture classes in the project KG. With no topic it lists instances directly from the project KG; by default it filters out historical records and, for topic searches, appends a small bounded set of linked neighbor records.
